title: Ipso Gallery at Fresh Produce
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Ipso Gallery at Fresh Produce is a unique art space that showcases artists we have a sincere appreciation for and think we can learn from. Ipso explores the ideas behind the art and the creative processes involved in making it, not just the results alone, as we pursue exhibitions of interest for fun or challenge.
